payload.purpose_context: Issues #199 to #207 were split from #116 after the sidebar, frame and header carrier work. Research on Starlight 0.42.6 (docs/architecture/research/layout-guards-and-decisions.md) re-measured them, found two more defects (#216, #217), and the owner chose an option for each. This mission adds the missing guards (determinism, target size, the published sidebar, the header fixture, the no-sidebar recentre) and ships the chosen layout changes (an inline sidebar reveal, aligned header search, toggle clearance, a 120rem default page cap, and a band-width persona card).
